definitions.explanation: A work of visual art created by applying paint or other media to a surface.

examples.english: I went to see a painting exhibition.

notes:
{絵画|かいが} is a formal term for paintings and visual artwork.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {絵画|かいが}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|か}く→描く：02013_egaku⟧ (to paint a picture)
- {絵画|かいが}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{収集|しゅうしゅう}→収集：11829_shuushuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to collect paintings)
- {絵画|かいが}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{鑑賞|かんしょう}→鑑賞：14516_kanshou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to appreciate paintings)

COMPOUNDS:
- {絵画|かいが}⟦{展|てん}→展：noentry⟧ (painting exhibition)
- {絵画|かいが}⟦{教室|きょうしつ}→教室：00794_kyoushitsu⟧ (painting class)
- ⟦{油絵|あぶらえ}→油絵：07076_aburae⟧{絵画|かいが} (oil painting)

TYPES:
- ⟦{西洋|せいよう}→西洋：01446_seiyou⟧{絵画|かいが} (Western painting)
- ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧{絵画|かいが} (Japanese painting)
- ⟦{抽象|ちゅうしょう}→抽象：08670_chuushou⟧{絵画|かいが} (abstract painting)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{絵|え}→絵：02613_e⟧: picture, painting (casual)
- {絵画|かいが}: painting (formal, art context)
- ⟦{画|が}→画：noentry⟧: painting (in compounds)
